text:
elaine: Sara from PwC asked for proof that RBAC changes are audited & KMS rotations are linked to key IDs. Need to bundle a sample evidence set + short runbook for reproduction.

sara (auditor): Can you include: 1) list of role-binding changes for last 90d with PR links, 2) KMS rotation logs with key IDs and rotation timestamps, 3) one vuln triage ticket linking to an incident and remediation timeline, and 4) a short explanation of how emergency access is revoked.

matt: quick Q — do we include automated Terraform plan diffs or just the GitHub PRs? :thinking: 

elaine: PRs + plan diffs would be ideal. Auditor wants proof of approval + who merged. Redact any secrets from diffs.

kevin: I can export KMS rotation events from CloudTrail. Command I ran earlier: 
``
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-12-01 --end-time 2025-03-01
```
That returns EventTime, Username, RequestParameters.keyId. I'll export CSV.

matt: For RBAC changes here's a sample Splunk query to pull role-binding updates:
``
index=infra_logs sourcetype=k8s_audit action=update object.kind=RoleBinding OR object.kind=ClusterRoleBinding | table _time user object.name requestURI
```
Will export to CSV as well.

elaine: I'll assemble a ZIP at s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1767004321-soc2-sample.zip with: PRs (pdfs), plan-diffs, cloudtrail.csv, splunk_export.csv, vuln-ticket.pdf, runbook.md.

sara (auditor): For the vuln triage item: please include CVE refs, timeline (discovery -> triage -> deploy), and rollback proof if used.

matt: We have ticket RW-1023 with links. I can attach the timeline and deployment k8s rollout hash. Example rollout command output I'll include as screenshot:
``
kubectl rollout history deploy/frontend --revision=5
```

kevin: Note: KMS rotation events older than 180 days are archived to Glacier; include pointer to archived manifest in S3: s3://redwood-archives/kms-rotations/2024Q3-manifest.json so auditor can request retrieval if needed.

elaine: One more auditor ask — how we handle emergency access during incidents. I'll add our emergency admin play: who grants, TTL (1h), approval flow, and audited revocation steps. Also include an IAM session audit snippet.

ci-bot: evidence-export job started: job id 7865, exporting splunk and cloudtrail slices.

matt: I'll redact user emails in PR screenshots. Anyone object to redacting emails but keeping usernames? :thumbsup: 

sara (auditor): Fine as long as traceability is preserved (you can provide a separate mapping file in the audit vault that maps redacted -> internal id).

elaine: OK wrapping up — planned deliverable ETA EOD today. I'll post S3 link here once upload completes.

ci-bot: evidence-export job 7865 completed: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1767004321-soc2-sample.zip

sara (auditor): Received, will review and ping if followups. Thanks everyone :pray:
